title: Reading the News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
abstract: arXiv:2610.22745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models that read financial news are usually trained on text from the same years used to test them, so a backtest can reward hindsight. We build news topics from NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, adapted into a sentence encoder by contrastive fine-tuning on passages of the same article, with no labels or returns. We compare it with LDA, MiniLM and FinBERT readers on 1.26 million articles from 2012 to 2024, convert each reader's topics into attention shocks and stock exposures, and forecast the returns of the 1,000 largest US stocks with eight models at three rebalancing frequencies. Models are fitted on 2013-2019, choices are made on 2020-2021, and 2022-2024 is held out. The experiment with the best validation score loses money at every frequency. translated_title: 无后见之明的新闻阅读：NoLBERT主题与股票截面收益
translated_abstract: 读取金融新闻的语言模型通常是在与测试年份相同的文本上训练的，因此回测可能因后见之明而受益。我们基于NoLBERT构建新闻主题，NoLBERT是一个仅在1976年至1995年间发布的文本上进行预训练的编码器，并通过对同一文章的段落进行对比学习微调，将其适配为句子编码器，整个过程不使用任何标签或收益率数据。我们在2012年至2024年的126万篇文章上，将其与LDA、MiniLM和FinBERT等阅读器进行比较，将每个阅读器的主题转换为注意力冲击和股票暴露，并用八个模型在三种再平衡频率下预测美国市值最大的1,000只股票的收益率。模型在2013-2019年数据上拟合，选择在2020-2021年数据上做出，2022-2024年数据被留出用于测试。验证得分最好的实验在每种频率下都出现亏损。将注意力冲击的衡量窗口从过去5个交易日改为过去63个交易日，能提高所有阅读器的测试秩IC（rank IC）。NoLBERT给出最稳……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出仅使用1976-1995年历史文本预训练的NoLBERT编码器来构建无后见之明偏差的新闻主题，并发现将注意力冲击衡量窗口延长至63个交易日可显著提升基于新闻的股票截面收益预测效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, to build hindsight-free news topics, and shows that measuring attention shocks over 63 trading days instead of 5 improves cross-sectional stock return predictability.
